integrity: Mathematical proof and executable exact enumeration supplied; the independent whole-number scan through 13000 is corroboration, not the global argument.
scientific_limitations: Squarefree integers with exactly four distinct prime factors only; three distinct omitted proper divisors are required. Classification relies on a proved finite reduction and a reproducible exact integer certificate; no claim about higher-support or nonsquarefree numbers. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Squarefree four-prime integers with three omitted divisors: a complete classification
